decision: FAIL: total-byte saving misses gate, generic PCA is smaller/more accurate; independent coefficients need free state
facts: Aligned orbit: Mirror 16,699 B / functional NRMSE 5.03e-4; free Tucker 17,559 B / 2.93e-4; generic PCA 16,887 B / 3.56e-4.
Mirror saves 4.9% vs free Tucker, below the preregistered 10% gate; generic PCA is 1.1% larger than Mirror and more accurate.
Independent coefficients: free Tucker NRMSE 2.92e-4; Mirror NRMSE 1.036 and PCA 0.781.
Shared K×32×32 bank is included in all payloads and dominates total bytes. Mirror angle fit ~2.1 ms vs PCA ~0.27 ms.
interpretation: A structured Givens coefficient code compresses the task state but adds little to total Tucker storage because the shared bank dominates. Generic PCA is more accurate at near-equal payload; unrelated layer coefficients require free task-specific coefficients.
hypothesis: Rejected for the registered >=10% total storage improvement and for independent layer functions.
counter_hypothesis: A larger layer count or smaller bank could increase amortized coefficient savings; not tested here.
limitations: Synthetic matrix bank, no real Transformer layer weights
Aligned teacher coefficients generated from Givens orbit
No downstream language loss or fused inference kernel
